condition: A brand misses target in a region (achievement < 70%) AND its SKUs have repeated stock-outs there
action: Expedite replenishment and escalate to the regional supply lead

condition: A brand misses target (< 80%) while a promotion is running with weak uplift (< 10%)
action: Review promo effectiveness with the brand team

condition: A brand misses target (< 80%) with NO stock-out and NO promotion in the period
action: Commission a market-visit / competitor check for the brand in that region

condition: A single distributor is out of stock for more than 6 weeks on a SKU
action: Raise a replenishment order for that distributor

condition: A brand over-delivers against target in a region (achievement > 110%)
action: Capture what worked and redeploy field effort elsewhere

condition: A brand misses target with no stock-out, no promotion, and no supporting note
action: Flag for manual review; do not auto-attribute a cause
Consider extending or replicating the mechanic in a comparable region

condition: A distributor shows stock-outs across 3 or more SKUs in a month
